verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CRUD operations via the MCP server and various individual automation features (invoicing, reminders, reconciliation), but there is no documentation of a bulk/batch operation capability (e.g., updating or creating many records in a single call) for AI-native use. One community note even suggests rule automation has limits ('Rules cannot be applied to these transactions'), further indicating no robust bulk-processing support. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API endpoints, evidence of processing many items in one operation, and confirmation that MCP tools support batch calls rather than one-at-a-time CRUD.
